  => Three phrasings of the same place resolve to THREE different wrong
     countries (NL / GB / US). The geocoder is NOT anchored to the user's
     location; it scatters on global POI name matches biased by the caller IP.
     Mapbox Search Box /forward + /suggest DEFAULT proximity=ip (doc-confirmed,
     below) and the IP is the Supabase edge datacenter, not the device.

THREAD 1 — TOO FEW SUGGESTIONS — CONFIRMED:
  The Preferences field routes through geocodingService.autocomplete() which
  calls forward (limit=1) and wraps the single feature into a 1-element array
  (geocodingService.ts:216-223). forward returns exactly ONE feature (see A1/A2/A3).
  A list is structurally impossible on this path.

(b) PROXIMITY/COUNTRY FIX — PROVEN-BY-PROXY (live) + doc-confirmed mechanism:
  suggest "lekki" (multi-row, A4) ALREADY returns the CORRECT place:
     #1 "Lekki Phase 2" — Lagos, Lagos, Nigeria
     #3 "Lekki Phase 1" — Lagos, Lagos, Nigeria
  mixed with noise (#2 Lekki Dubai UAE, #4 Poland, #5 UK). This proves Mapbox
  RETURNS Lekki, Lagos NG when not constrained to the single IP-biased result.
  Adding country=ng would restrict to Nigeria (drop Dubai/Poland/UK); adding
  proximity=<Lagos lng,lat> would rank Lekki Lagos first. The exact direct
  "&proximity=3.4,6.45&country=ng" Mapbox call was NOT executed because
  MAPBOX_ACCESS_TOKEN is a Supabase secret (NOT API-readable) and no public
  Mapbox token is provisioned (per INVESTIGATE_ORCH-1162R). This caps ONLY the
  direct-param sub-proof; the root cause and fix mechanism are otherwise proven.

MAPBOX SEARCH BOX DOC VERIFICATION (https://docs.mapbox.com/api/search/search-box/):
  proximity : DEFAULT "ip" when omitted; format "longitude,latitude" (or "ip").
              "If not provided, the default is IP proximity."
  country   : comma-separated ISO 3166 alpha-2 codes.
  types     : country|region|postcode|district|place|city|locality|neighborhood|
              street|address|poi|category (comma-separated).
  limit     : up to 10 (both /suggest and /forward).
  session_token : /suggest + /retrieve only (NOT /forward); UUIDv4 recommended.
